title: Running time and outcome of clearing
statement: Let $k$ be the number of work tapes, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, choose a tape $i<k$, and let $w$ assign a Boolean word to each tape. There is a time $T\le 2|w_i|+2$ such that the clearing machine has not reached its done state at any time $t<T$, and at time $T$ its configuration is the initial configuration with state done and tape $i$ replaced by the empty word.
hypotheses_covered: no done state at any time $t<T$
